excludedFromThisProfile.sourceRefs: Configurator 9 and cabinet table 581 come from the manifest and hold Mako data, so the colour catalogs are read from configurator 9 instead of being listed here; a colour it offers without a SKU is not offered. Countertop table 577 comes from the manifest and holds Mako data.
excludedFromThisProfile.matteWhite8cm: Listed in the Master File (L121) but Mako has thin countertops only (map section 7, D-P0184), so it is not offered.
excludedFromThisProfile.va023: Listed in the Master File (L195) but bound to the thick 3.1" Technomat top in GB row 14, which thin-only excludes (section 9).
excludedFromThisProfile.va030: Confirmed for SS Texturizzato by GB row 13 and the price workbook, but absent from the Master File, so it is not offered until the product list is fixed (section 9).
excludedFromThisProfile.legsOnlyForTwoDrawers: Confirmed: legs exist only for 2DW (section 6, D-P0173). The profile has no availability rule for it, and the Master File does not say when Leg Color is shown (Q-MAKO-002). The scene shows the legs only with a leg colour and hides them on 1DW (runtime-bindings.json); a leg colour kept from a 2DW cabinet is not reset on 1DW yet.
excludedFromThisProfile.legsQuantityAndPrice: Leg height 33.3 cm and prices $745 / $1,340 are known, and so is the unit: $745 / $1,340 is the price of one leg and a configuration takes a pair (team, 24.09.2026), which is what the SKU profile orders. Positions are still not given (section 6, Q-MAKO-003).
excludedFromThisProfile.handleColorByStyle: Gold and Silver are shown for both handles, lacquered colours only for G57; lacquered G50 is neither confirmed nor forbidden (section 4).
excludedFromThisProfile.handleG50Length: G50 comes in 20 and 36 cm; which cabinet width takes which length is not described (sections 4, 16).
excludedFromThisProfile.handleAndColorMixing: Whether handles, handle colours, leg colours and cabinet colours must be shared by the whole composition is not described (sections 4, 5).
excludedFromThisProfile.heightByStyle: Confirmed: 1DW is 26 cm high, 2DW 52 cm (section 2). The scene gets the height with the style (runtime-bindings.json), and the builder catalog from the cabinet table rows (table 581, forced_height_cm 1:26|2:52).
excludedFromThisProfile.widths: Confirmed: Sink Base 60/80/100/120 cm, Side Cabinet 40/60/80/100/120 cm, depth 52 cm (section 3). Cabinet table rows (table 581).
excludedFromThisProfile.compositionLimits: Confirmed: at most 220 cm, at most two Sink Bases, cabinets abut only (section 3, D-P0161-D-P0163). Not expressible in the profile yet.
excludedFromThisProfile.thickness: Mako has thin countertops only: 0.5" for six material groups; Porcelain is 0.8" in the tables but 3/4" in the catalog (section 7). No thickness catalog is declared until the profile is confirmed.
excludedFromThisProfile.basinByMaterialAndMinWidth: Confirmed in GB: material -> integrated basin, Sink Base at least 60 cm (sections 7, 9). Needs Mako rows in the countertop table.
excludedFromThisProfile.basinPosition: Standard or closer to the wall when there are no faucet holes, except LB856 and VA030 (section 9). No offsets are given.
excludedFromThisProfile.floating: Mentioned, but it needs a thick countertop and Mako has thin ones only, so no floating option is valid today (section 12).
excludedFromThisProfile.vesselCutoutPerSb: A vessel needs a cutout per Sink Base (section 11, D-P0191). An order line, not an option.
excludedFromThisProfile.solidSurfaceGroups: Technolite, Technomood and Texturizzato are separate price groups with no palette of their own; the Master File has Matte White only (section 7).
excludedFromThisProfile.vesselAssets: Iris, Frame and Plaza are named; their colours, minimum Sink Base, cutout drawings and prices are not given (section 10).
excludedFromThisProfile.productIdGap: Master File row L100 has an empty ProductID (Q-MAKO-001).
